topic: how do we refund a customer over $500?
text: Customer Acme wants a $750 refund for a duplicate charge. What's the process for refunds over $500?

replies.text: Over $500 needs escalation to the Billing Lead (me, currently). I verify the charge in Stripe and check for repeat refund history before approving. Then you issue via Stripe and log in Zendesk.
got it — so verify charge, escalate to you, you approve, then I issue + log. thanks!
exactly. and remember the hard limit: never more than 2x the original charge. anything beyond that goes to Head of Finance.

text: seeing a spike of refund requests from a cluster of new accounts. flagging as possible fraud.

replies.text: good catch. hold all refunds for those accounts. I'm paging eng-oncall — this looks coordinated abuse.
ack, investigating. will follow incident-response runbook. rolling back the recent signup-flow deploy as a precaution.

topic: can I refund to a different card?
text: customer changed cards and wants the refund on the new one. can we do that?

replies.text: no — policy says original payment method only. refund to the original card even if it's expired; the bank handles it. log the reason code in Zendesk.

text: checkout started returning 500s at 14:00. identified as a bad config push. rolled back at 14:08. posting updates to #status every 30 min.

replies.text: postmortem assigned to me, due in 2 business days. action items will be Jira tickets with owners.
was there any revenue impact? need numbers for the exec update.

text: need to hotfix a checkout bug — it's Friday 4pm. can we deploy?

replies.text: after 3pm Friday needs a Director's sign-off per deploy-policy. is this SEV1?
SEV2, customers hitting errors. getting director approval now.

text: prospect wants 20% off. I can do 15% without approval but need sign-off above that, right?

replies.text: correct. up to 15% is yours. 15-25% needs Sales Manager. above 25% needs VP Sales. log every exception in Salesforce.
thanks — sending to my manager for approval.

text: how big a goodwill credit can I issue without escalating?

replies.text: under $200, any AE can issue. above $200 comes to Sales Ops. never backdate a pricing change and never offer a lifetime deal without written VP approval.

text: first week here — where exactly do I log a refund?

replies.text: log it in the Zendesk ticket with the reason code. Stripe is the system of record for the money; Zendesk is the audit trail. both for every refund, no exceptions.
